workspace_thread_note: One thread for this venture. Demo responses.
workspace_local_reply: Added to this working thread. A useful next step is to connect this question to an experiment and define what evidence would change the current design. This is a demo response.
workspace_initial_question: Find concepts like this that work in comparable European cities.
workspace_initial_reply: The reference shortlist includes Vienna and Berlin. A possible gap is specialist herbal advice with custom blends in Rhine-Main. Treat this as a lead to investigate, not evidence of local demand.

workspace_reference_note: Five businesses from the approved Scout reference. Descriptions and comparison values are demo material, not independently verified research.
workspace_benchmark_0: Loose medicinal herbs, custom blends, in-store advice and an online shop.
workspace_benchmark_1: Medicinal teas and herbal remedies through pharmacies and own channels.
workspace_benchmark_2: Individual herb blends alongside a regular pharmacy offer.
workspace_benchmark_3: Dried herbs, blends and supplements delivered nationwide.
workspace_benchmark_4: Medicinal herbs by weight, teas and extracts in a smartshop format.
workspace_gap_text: The approved reference suggests a dedicated herbal pharmacy may be missing in Rhine-Main. Check existing specialists and customer alternatives before treating this as a market gap.
workspace_comparison_note: Illustrative coverage: ● full · ◐ half · ◔ quarter · ○ none. These are reference judgements, not measured scores.
workspace_next_step: Turn the opportunity into a question →
workspace_prompt_reply: The demo brief is set to herbal health retail in Europe. The five reference businesses show different formats; compare advice and custom blends before choosing what to test locally.
workspace_idea_title: A current concept, open to change
workspace_idea_copy: A specialist pharmacy for medicinal herbs, custom blends and expert advice in Rhine-Main. Traditional remedies form the starting point; any expanded range depends on a product-specific regulatory and licensing review.
workspace_idea_next: Explore alternatives, then test why people would choose this pharmacy.
workspace_hypotheses_intro: Four working assumptions drawn from the pathway. Priorities are proposed for this demo; none are validated by the illustrative results.
workspace_hyp_0: The intended range can be offered within a viable licensing model.
workspace_why_0: This determines which offering can exist at all. Illustrative clearance counts do not establish actual permission.
workspace_hyp_1: Customers will switch from existing sources at the intended price.
workspace_why_1: Interest alone does not show willingness to change buying behaviour or pay.
workspace_hyp_2: A local counter can generate sufficient paying transactions.
workspace_why_2: The pop-up result is pending. A regional gap is not evidence of demand.
workspace_hyp_3: Transactions can contribute enough to cover operating costs.
workspace_why_3: Rent, staff, stock and billing costs can change whether the concept is viable.
workspace_experiments_intro: Open any module. The pathway supplies the methods and evidence; its phase states describe the demo programme, not proof that assumptions hold.
workspace_learnings_intro: No verified learning is recorded in this prototype. Use the illustrative evidence to see how a result could affect the next decision.
workspace_support_note: The following example results are above their example benchmarks. They are not research findings and do not validate the venture.
workspace_contradict_note: None recorded. This does not mean that no contradiction exists; collect customer objections and alternative explanations.
workspace_implications_copy: Demand and contribution are still open. Revisit the customer and offering assumptions before committing to a permanent location.
workspace_design_intro: What we currently believe the business could be. Validation can change this draft; a design change creates new questions to test.
workspace_customer_current: Health-conscious Rhine-Main residents seeking herbal remedies and personal advice.
workspace_customer_assumption: The priority segment and its willingness to switch are not established.
workspace_problem_current: Access to specialist advice and tailored herbal blends in one local place.
workspace_problem_assumption: We still need to understand how customers solve this today and what is missing.
workspace_value_current: Medicinal herbs, individual blends and knowledgeable advice together.
workspace_value_assumption: Advice must create enough value to change purchase behaviour.
workspace_offering_current: Traditional herbal remedies and consultations; an expanded range remains conditional on regulatory review.
workspace_offering_assumption: The permitted range, licensing and reliable supply are unresolved.
workspace_market_current: Rhine-Main as the initial catchment, with European reference formats to investigate.
workspace_market_assumption: The potential gap in specialist retail has not been verified locally.
workspace_gtm_current: A landing-page and pop-up counter can explore whether the offer attracts local customers.
workspace_gtm_assumption: Acquisition channels and conversion at the required daily rate remain open.
workspace_economics_current: Assess transaction contribution against rent, staff, stock, licensing and billing costs.
workspace_economics_assumption: No verified unit economics or financial forecast is available.
workspace_model_current: A specialist retail pharmacy with advice. Reimbursed and out-of-pocket purchases need separate consideration.
workspace_model_assumption: The reimbursement mix and cost of administering claims remain assumptions.
workspace_ask_design: Which evidence would change this design?
